title: AI4IA Foundry A2A integration design manifest
description: Validation and planning contract for a proposed A2A integration. It is deliberately not callable: the repository has no validated protocol/version negotiation, endpoint discovery, backend auth, APIM operation/product/policy, or runtime client wiring. scripts/provision-foundry-a2a.py validates and reports those blockers; it does not emit executable commands or an AgentSpec.

lifecycle.description: Validated design artifact only; no callable integration is provisioned or served.

agentName.description: Proposed Foundry agent identifier. This design does not prove that the agent exists or expose an endpoint.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the app's @-menu when the remote agent is registered.

description.description: What the remote agent does (helps routing/delegation).

linkAs.description: Local catalog agent name to register the remote A2A agent as, so other agents can delegate to it via their `links`. Lowercase slug.

blockingRequirements.description: Executable contracts that must be designed, implemented, and tested before lifecycle may become active.
